data.name: Dilesh
data.gender_notes: Dilesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Dilesh is derived from the words ‘Dila’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Isha’ meaning ‘Lord’ or ‘Messenger’. This name is given to a child believed to be a messenger of God. The name Dilesh carries the meaning “God's messenger” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dilesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's messenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and service to the divine.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dilesh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dilesh holds significant cultural relevance within the Hindu community. It showcases the deep-rooted faith in the divine, emphasizing the belief that every individual is a creation of God, and can serve as His messenger in the world. It is a name that evokes a sense of respect, devotion, and responsibility towards God and His creation.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Dilesh lies in its profound connection to the divine. It denotes that the child has a divine purpose and is here to represent God in the world. This belief instills in the child a strong sense of duty, morality, and the importance of leading a pious and righteous life. It serves as a constant reminder of their connection to the divine and the role they play in spreading love, kindness, and positivity in the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Dilesh is derived from Sanskrit, meaning "Dwelling in the heart of Rama." It reflects an individual's deep devotion and love for Lord Rama, symbolizing inner peace, devotion, and a strong connection to the divine.

historical_references.reference: According to Hindu mythology, Dilesh is a name of Lord Vishnu and is considered a form of Krishna. In the ancient Sanskrit text, Bhagavata Purana, Dilesh is mentioned as the one who appeared in Dwarka to protect King Prithu from a demon named Indra. Prithu was a great king of the solar dynasty and a devotee of Lord Vishnu.

Dilesh is also mentioned in the medieval text, 'Bhagavatam', as a name of Krishna. In this text, Dilesh is described as the protector of the Yadava clan and is often invoked by devotees during times of distress. The text also mentions that Dilesh appeared to help Krishna in his battle against the demon Narakasura.

In the tech industry, Dilesh might be the founder or CTO of a tech startup, showcasing their innovative products or services on LinkedIn. Within digital marketing, Dilesh may use Instagram to promote brand content and engage with followers, while providing marketing advice and analysis on Twitter. Overall, the name 'Dilesh' is associated with modern professionals using various digital platforms to connect, create, and grow.
